== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_76</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 77), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-77-Master_Luke.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-masterluke-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Master Luke (V) (Virtual Block 3)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “[Pilot] 2. During battle, may use 2 Force to place an opponent’s alien (except Jabba or a Rep) present with Luke in owner’s Force Pile (opponent may use or lose 3 Force instead). Immune to attrition < 4 (< 7 if with an alien leader).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_76</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB3-77-Master_Luke-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B06 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
